sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower support · Manuals and specifications
sources.notes: Family-level chassis dimensions and mass. These values constrain the outer envelope, not internal component coordinates.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower motherboard layout
sources.notes: Official Dell board map. Callouts identify connector positions and expansion-slot functions; they do not establish a measured PCB coordinate system or installed optional modules.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower system board removal
sources.locator: Removing system board — prerequisite removal list, cable disconnection and board fasteners
sources.notes: Manufacturer sequence used for the partial board-removal workflow. Optional components are only removed when fitted; this is not a universal teardown of every possible configuration.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower processor specifications
sources.notes: Supported CPU options only; no particular processor is asserted as installed. A service-manual processor table differs on some thermal-power values, so the package records the setup/specification table and flags this source discrepancy.

sources.locator: Memory type, speed, slot count and maximum capacity

sources.locator: M.2 SSD, SATA drive options, supported form factors and storage combinations
sources.notes: Supported storage configurations, not proof of installed drive population.

sources.notes: Manufacturer connector capability and generation information; no cable path or fitted-device state is implied.

sources.locator: 260 W PSU variants and AC input characteristics

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower screw-size list
sources.notes: Documents listed screw types and quantities. Table sum must not be treated as installed screw count in every build.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower heatsink removal
sources.locator: Loosen four captive heatsink screws in the numbered 1–4 sequence
sources.notes: Supports the documented fastener group and screw-release order; no torque value or exact screw coordinates are stated.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower processor removal
sources.locator: Release socket lever and processor cover after heatsink removal
sources.notes: Manufacturer warning about delicate socket contacts; no processor is selected for this family-level package.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower system fan removal
sources.locator: Disconnect intrusion-switch and fan cables; release rubber grommets
sources.notes: Documents fan cable routing through a mounting grommet and the elastomer mounting method. Exact grommet dimensions are not provided.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower power supply removal
sources.locator: Disconnect and unroute cables, release three PSU mounting screws and chassis tab
sources.notes: Manufacturer PSU removal procedure; model-specific cable routing and PSU part number are not captured by the family proxy.
